units.source_text: 声音让风给吹散了，听上去像便捷式半导体收音机里发出的没有起伏的声音。

en.t: The voice was scattered by the wind, and it sounded like the flat, uninflected sound coming from a portable transistor radio.

units.source_text: 语调倒也抑扬顿挫，没什么听不清楚的地方。

en.t: The intonation did rise and fall, and there was nothing particularly hard to make out.
